sections.name: Walk
sections.description: His stalking stride, machete carried forward. ONE STEP PER LAP, not two — the foot spread rises to a single maximum at frame 6 (360 px against 80 at frame 0) and falls away again, where a full stride shows two. Frame 14 closes back onto frame 0's phase (mask IoU 0.65 against 0.42 for the mid-cycle frame 7), so the loop is seamless, but he leads with the same leg every lap. At 15 frames / 30 fps that is 0.5 s a step, 120 a minute — an ordinary walking cadence, which is why it reads as a low crouched shuffle rather than as a limp. If a two-step take is ever exported, replace this and re-measure the plants below.

note: Cell 15 of the 4x4 grid is empty (0 opaque px) — the frame list stops at 14 so the loader never walks it. Background is already transparent; this sheet needs no chroma key. ART FACES LEFT, which is the opposite of every Agbero and Senior Agbero sheet — see SHAVEDWALK_SHEET.faces in game.js.
